target_customer: Importers from small consumer brands to large companies that ship internationally and pay duties and tariffs
problem: Companies overpay duties and struggle with customs paperwork and freight logistics. Forge started with hardware procurement and moved to duty drawback and then full AI-native freight forwarding and customs brokerage.
business_model: Freight forwarding and customs brokerage service fees, plus a share of duty drawback and tariff refunds
product_category: AI-native freight forwarder and customs broker

founders.name: Emir Sahmanovic
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was a lead engineer on rocket engines at Stoke Space. Education not listed.

founders.name: Haris Sahmanovic
founders.background_notes: Backend engineer. Brother of Emir. Education not listed.

competitors.name: KlearNow.AI
competitors.what: AI-powered customs brokerage and clearance software and service
competitors.traction_then: Launched a Customs Engine in 2023 and KlearHub in January 2024, operating in several countries

technical_complexity.rationale: Software for quoting, document handling and customs filing is standard engineering. The harder parts are licensing and operations rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: Customs brokerage needs licensed brokers and operational relationships with carriers, which slows copycats, but AI tooling itself is easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Flexport later launched AI agents to automate tariff refunds, per a trade press article found in search. The exact date was not verified.

market_need_then: Tariff and duty costs were a rising pain for importers. The company's own launch post described duty drawback, where companies recover duties on goods later exported or scrapped. Dated demand figures were not found.

identity.visual_style: Product mockups of shipment tracking and refund dashboards
identity.voice_and_tone: Short and confident, for example Global trade, handled.

brand_strength.rationale: Customer logos on the site show traction with consumer brands, but the generic name is shared with many other companies including a gaming platform and an AI automation platform.

pivots.from: AI-powered procurement platform for hardware companies
pivots.why: Not stated. Press in mid 2024 described procurement, and the YC page now describes duty drawback.

pivots.to: AI-native freight forwarder and customs broker

outcome_analysis: Forge raised a small seed in mid 2024 on a hardware procurement idea, then moved into duty drawback and later full freight forwarding and customs brokerage for brands such as Allegiant Airlines and r.e.m. beauty. It remains active with a seven person team and no later round was found. Tariff turbulence created demand, but well funded incumbents like Flexport entered the same wedge.
notes: TechCrunch headline slug says 2M and a search snippet said 2.1M, and CB Insights lists 2.6M total across two rounds with the latest a 2.1M seed on 2024-06-04. The second round was not identified, so coverage is partial. I saw TechCrunch and Gradient only as search snippets, not full pages. The Sahmanovic founders' education was not found.
